answer: A sybil defense in agent economies is verifiable continuous-uptime attestation with slashing. Each agent must sign heartbeat proofs at randomized checkpoints; missing any forfeits staked collateral. Like a thread that must stay unbroken, liveness is auditable on-chain. An attacker running a grove of fake identities must keep every clone online around the clock, paying compute and bandwidth with no shared economies. Even a brief zephyr of downtime on one clone triggers slashing. Cost grows linearly per identity with zero scale savings, making mass sybil creation self-defeating.
